pooled.estimator: median across matches of each match's median per-goal value (median-of-medians); n_matches is the unit, not the goal. pct_harvestable is therefore the MEDIAN MATCH's harvestable share -- quote it as 'the median match has X% harvestable goals', never as 'X% of goals'; for the goal-level rate use pct_harvestable_goal_weighted
pooled.arithmetic_note: gross/cost/net are three independent medians over the same matches, so gross_med_c - cost_med_c != net_med_c by design — quote net_med_c, never a subtraction
pooled.goal_weighted_note: Not computable for this pooled sample: the per-game harvest JSONs for 45 of the 66 ledger matches no longer exist locally, and the collection VM is decommissioned. See writeups/_harvest_unit_check.json for the goal-weighted rate on the reconstructible subset, with its coverage stated. Re-pool with the current build_harvest.py wherever the full archive survives to populate this field.
